item.title: New Factory Team 1/28th Scale Aluminum Pinion Sets
item.description: A new line of aluminum pinion gears are now available from Factory Team! These pinion gear sets all come with three pinion gears, and are offered in three different ranges, depending on which 1/28th scale motor is being used.

item.title: Jeff Statkiewicz Joins Team Yokomo USA
item.description: Team Yokom USA is beyond excited to have Jeff Statkiewicz join the team for 2026.

item.title: 2026 JConcepts Off-Road Jam Results
item.description: Despite winter weather forecasts that at one point called for up to 15 inches of snow (spoiler alert: they were very wrong), nearly 200 entries braved the cold and packed Fastlane Raceway for another unforgettable Offroad JAM weekend.

item.title: New JConcepts 2026 Apparel Line
item.description: JConcepts reloads for the 2026 season with new apparel to go with a fresh and rejuvenated racing team.

item.title: New Team Saxo F1 Pre-Mounts
item.description: T-Saxo Racing has announced their newest product, 1/10 F1 Pre-Glued Rubber Tires.

item.title: New Team Xray X4F Front Balancing Weights
item.description: Team Xray has released new X4F front left and front right 45g brass weights that are moved from the bumper to under the front driveshafts in the center of the front drive train for improved weight transfer on & off power.

item.title: New Klinik RC 10 Year Anniversary Apparel
item.description: Klinik RC has released their new 10 year anniversary apparel for 2026.

item.title: New RC Discharger Storage Case
item.description: RC Discharger designed a case to address travel storage needs, offering a professional solution for transporting our 2S and 4S discharging systems.

item.title: New HRC Racing Large Race Bag
item.description: The HRC Racing RACE BAG L offers optimal storage space for RC models in scales 1/16 to 1/8. It is designed to provide a practical and reliable transport solution for models and accessories used in everyday RC activities.

item.title: Industry Analytics Weekly Stats [1/21 - 1/28]
item.description: Another week of steady 15,000+ entries in the #LiveTimeScoring system for this week's #IndustryAnalytics.
